LESSON: READING 9.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: CLASS READER

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.4: Reading 9.4.1 Intensive reading: Class Reader
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 9.4.1 Intensive reading: Class Reader, part of Strand 9 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What marks the climax of a story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read sections of a class reader and explain the sequence of events,

2. work with peers to dramatise parts of the class reader for clarity,

3. outline the actions of each character studied in the section,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read sections of a class reader and explain the sequence of events,
2. work with peers to dramatise parts of the class reader for clarity,
3. outline the actions of each character studied in the section,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 9.4.1 Intensive reading: Class Reader together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner participates actively in dramatising parts of the class reader for conceptualisation.

• Critical thinking and problem-solving: It is developed as the learner comes up with possible options as solutions to problems

portrayed in the class reader.

Values:
Respect is enhanced as the learner respects diverse opinions while working with peers to dramatise parts of the class reader.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Ethical relationships are enhanced as the learner relates issues of relationships in the class reader to real life.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates performance skills to the concept of performance techniques in Creative Arts and Sports.
